Due to low participation in some class tournaments, please note these important changes:

notes.title: [Notice] DamHwaLyn Update Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello, SOF Community![/h1]


Finally, after months of waiting, new character [b]“DamHwaLyn”[/b] has arrived! 

Much appreciate SOF players for waiting her.

“DamHwaLyn” is the main female character of Scions of Fate 
and a best friend of Hanbia, using “Death Flower Leaf Sword”. 
This character shows better evasion than the Sword.

Now, let’s find out more about her😊

[h1]Create Character[/h1]

We should create “DamHwaLyn” character in advance.
Log in to our server and create DamHwaLyn.

▼ In the beginning, DamHwaLyn’s stat will be ideal to the sword-class character.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31310500/cfb5c07ee4c47d75abf07c2121b54c6138fe414d.png[/img]

▼ Give your character a name and get ready to start!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31310500/85ab4493d8d6f61cbea8ee59b1079dc45152680d.png[/img]

[h1]Weapon (Death Flower Leaf Sword)[/h1]

Hero class Damhwalyn will only be using its own weapon, 
“Death Flower Leaf Sword” just like Hanbia character.

Please keep in mind that exchanging, selling or discarding 
“Death Flower Leaf Sword” will not be allowed. 

After character promotions, you will be able to upgrade the weapon 
through completing its own quests and the quests can be received from NPC Chan.

Whenever it levels up, “Death Flower Leaf Sword” will change its appearance 
and increase its attack rate. However, it has special enhance conditions to level up.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31310500/6a507808f2adf1a00a018655d45adb3e5d65edaf.png[/img]

The item, “Heavenly Protection Pill” can be obtained by completing the Quest, 
“King Mandock Heavenly Protection Pill(HanBiGwang)” from NPC GunWoo from Southern Forest.

▼ Death Flower Leaf Sword(8th) (True) 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31310500/7befdd0988e5fc81947bc5463ea875abaaf6a594.png[/img]

[h1]Skill[/h1]

Players can learn skills and make it stronger when the character levels up.
However, if you haven’t mastered the first skill, the following skills 
will not be able to be learned. In particular, Damhwalyn can register combo 
at the bottom of the Skill Window like below: 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31310500/89f30a516fdd9187475b697ddcb5bf145225e4c2.png[/img]

Combo activates by certain percentages while hunting monsters.
For “ALL KILL”, simply press the activated comments in order 
and you’ll get much Exp and gold!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31310500/b4b0e7e8a67f6ddb084350050facaf2ae7c84239.png[/img]

[h1]Ability[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31310500/4aed2ccf38ed40b93add477937657475f2c3c445.png[/img]

[h1]Promotion[/h1]

Promotion for Damhwalyn will be different from usual promotion system on SOF.
Players can meet characters from the original cartoon-like Hanbia character does.

Promotion quests for Damhwalyn are available at “Space-Time Gate”.
( Except 2nd and 3rd promotion quests.)

“Space-Time Gate” is located near NPC Sky Ryu in Central Valley. 
Players can easily find the place by simply clicking the red dot, “Space-Time Gate”.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31310500/2b2597a3707420ce3e70bfdec9859a68daf045ac.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31310500/8562dfc1e0715478c6c0234dc80fdd9ee5a5cbdf.png[/img]

[b]※ Last notice![/b]

Please be aware that the items below will not be able to use in-game.

a. Training Marble[Nidana]
b. Forgotten Title Abstract(weapon) / Forgotten Title Abstract(Cloth)
c. Glorious Title Abstract(Cloth) / Glorious Title Abstract(weapon) 

Thank you very much for reading the notice 
and once again much appreciate SOF players patience on this update. 

As always, we will do our best to make SOF better environment.

If you have any questions or problems regarding new update, 
please don’t hesitate to send us tickets. 

We look forward to hearing feedbacks or questions from players😊

notes.title: Steam Payment Policy Update
notes.notes:
Dear SOF community!

We have important announcement to make about our Steam payment system. 

In an effort to avoid chargeback issue that we have received recently, we will be changing the conditions of Steam payment.

Players will now have to meet the following conditions in order to avoid any potential nCash Chargeback abuse,
 
- Player Level 60 or more will be able to purchase nCash through Steam
- Player Level less than 60 will not be able to purchase nCash through Steam

Much appreciate your kind understanding of change in Steam payment policy.

Regards
Shadow
